title: Branch protection and deployment observation
objective: Inspect protection/rulesets and post-merge deployment/health status, retry only transient failures, and present rollback plans for explicit approval.
acceptance_criteria: Existing protection is inspected and never changed without approval.
Health-check failure halts further deployment actions.
No automatic rollback occurs; rollback plan requires explicit approval.
undo_classification: Never execute rollback automatically; preserve deployment evidence and present the exact plan for approval.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval before protection changes or rollback.
retry_policy: Only classified transient retries; repeated failure halts and escalates.
blocking_reasons: N14 merge lifecycle and approved Issue required.
